crest.prompt: Create one production game UI ornament asset on a genuinely transparent background, no text. Grimdark fantasy pixel art for Omega Realm, inspired by old Diablo inventory UI: a small front-facing weathered bone skull embedded in a narrow symmetrical dark iron and tarnished gold gothic crest, with a pointed top finial, tiny worn rivets, short thorn-like metal wings. Single compact horizontal ornament centered, tight composition, roughly 3:2 aspect ratio. Pixel art with deliberate hard pixel clusters, no smooth painterly shading, no blur, no soft shadow outside silhouette, no glow. Muted black iron #252928, antique gold #9B7428, bone #D8D0BC, dried blood #4A1512, bright highlights very restrained. Design to read when rendered at 120x80 pixels over a black menu panel and also as a compact health emblem. Transparent everywhere outside the crest. Only the crest, no UI panels, no background, no checkerboard, no lettering. Save the generated asset to disk and return its path.
